note: Two long-standing combat fixes. First, killing a townsfolk now earns XP exactly like killing a creature: a commoner pays what a goat does, a guard pays what a tougher monster does, and the same goes for simulated adventurers and travelers you kill — awarded once at death, through the same XP grant as every other kill. Second, NPCs that fight back now actually keep fighting: their hit cooldown was counted in world-clock ticks (one tick every 3 seconds, so a second hit could not land for over two minutes) — it now runs in real time at roughly one hit per second, like creature attacks — and fighting NPCs run after you instead of trailing behind at a walk, so a player who walks away still gets caught and hit, while sprinting away still escapes. The same fixes apply to NPCs fighting creatures
